title: A Big Deal in the Crypto World 🪙
body: A Big Deal in the Crypto World 🪙
Crypto exchange Kraken acquired investment firm Tribe Capital, which manages $2.7 billion in assets and counts companies such as SpaceX and OpenAI in its portfolio.

Simply put: the acquisition means a crypto trading platform is buying a traditional investment firm, bringing the worlds of traditional and digital finance together in one place. The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, and its value was not disclosed.
Do you think cryptocurrencies have become part of traditional finance?
